cases.explain: Впечатление is the grammatical subject of было (was), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Сама княгиня вышла замуж 30 лет тому назад по сватовству ___.
cases.translation: The princess herself had married 30 years before through her aunt's matchmaking.
cases.explain: Тетки shows possession (whose matchmaking), a noun-modifying genitive.

cases.sentence: Появление Левина было поводом к серьезному ___.
cases.translation: Levin's appearance was the occasion for a serious conversation.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward, occasion for) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: Choosing a husband for themselves is their own affair.
cases.explain: Мужа is the direct object of the transitive verb выбрать (to choose), so it is accusative.

cases.sentence: княгиня была рада и с ___ говорила мужу.
cases.translation: The princess was glad and spoke to her husband triumphantly.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) expressing manner governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Успехи ее в ___ были больше, чем обеих ее старших сестер.
cases.translation: Her success in society was greater than that of both her older sisters.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Княжне Ките Щербатской было восемнадцать лет.
reading.question: How old was Princess Kitty Shcherbatskaya?
reading.explain: The text states Княжне Ките Щербатской было восемнадцать лет — Princess Kitty was eighteen years old.

reading.ru: Успехи ее в свете были больше, чем обеих ее старших сестер, и больше, чем даже ожидала княгиня.
reading.question: How did Kitty's social success compare to her older sisters'?
options: It was greater than both her older sisters', exceeding even her mother's expectations
It was much less than theirs
It was about the same as theirs
She had no success at all
reading.correct: It was greater than both her older sisters', exceeding even her mother's expectations
reading.explain: The text says her success was greater than both older sisters', and greater than even the princess had expected.

reading.ru: уже в первую зиму представились две серьезные партии – Левин и, тотчас же после его отъезда, граф Вронский
reading.question: Which two serious suitors appeared for Kitty in her first winter out?
reading.explain: The text names Левин и ... граф Вронский as the two serious suitors.

reading.ru: Князь был на стороне Левина, говорил, что он ничего не желает лучшего для Китти.
reading.question: Whose side was the old prince on regarding Kitty's suitors?
options: He wanted Kitty to marry no one yet
reading.explain: The text says Князь был на стороне Левина — the prince was on Levin's side.

reading.ru: Когда же Левин внезапно уехал, княгиня была рада и с торжеством говорила мужу «Видишь, я была права».
reading.question: How did the princess react when Levin suddenly left?
options: She was glad and triumphantly told her husband she had been right
She insisted Levin be invited back
She blamed Kitty for his departure
reading.correct: She was glad and triumphantly told her husband she had been right
reading.explain: The text says she was glad and triumphantly told her husband «Видишь, я была права» — 'You see, I was right.'

reading.ru: Для матери не могло быть никакого сравнения между Вронским и Левиным.
reading.question: According to the princess, how did Vronsky and Levin compare?
options: There was no comparison between them at all, in Vronsky's favor
They were exactly equal in her eyes
She refused to think about either
reading.correct: There was no comparison between them at all, in Vronsky's favor
reading.explain: The text says для матери не могло быть никакого сравнения между Вронским и Левиным — there could be no comparison for the mother.

reading.ru: «Хорошо, что он так непривлекателен, что Китти не влюбилась в него», — думала мать.
reading.question: What did the mother think was fortunate about Levin?
options: That he was unattractive enough that Kitty had not fallen in love with him
That he was leaving for Petersburg
reading.correct: That he was unattractive enough that Kitty had not fallen in love with him
reading.explain: The mother thinks it fortunate that Levin was so unappealing that Kitty had not fallen in love with him.

reading.ru: Очень богат, умен, знатен, на пути блестящей военно-придворной карьеры и обворожительный человек.
reading.question: How is Vronsky described as satisfying the mother's wishes?
options: Very rich, intelligent, noble, on a brilliant military-court career path, and charming
reading.correct: Very rich, intelligent, noble, on a brilliant military-court career path, and charming
reading.explain: The text lists these qualities: очень богат, умен, знатен ... обворожительный человек.

reading.ru: Сама княгиня вышла замуж 30 лет тому назад по сватовству тетки.
reading.question: How had the princess herself gotten married 30 years earlier?
options: By her own free choice alone
reading.explain: The text says she married по сватовству тетки — through her aunt's matchmaking.

reading.ru: Сколько страхов было пережито, сколько мыслей передумано, сколько денег потрачено, сколько столкновений с мужем при выдаче замуж старших двух, Дарьи и Натальи.
reading.question: What did marrying off the two older daughters, Darya and Natalya, cost the princess?
options: Many fears, much thought, much money, and many clashes with her husband
Nothing at all, it was effortless
Only a small amount of money
Just a single argument with her husband
reading.correct: Many fears, much thought, much money, and many clashes with her husband
reading.explain: The text lists сколько страхов ... сколько столкновений с мужем — how many fears, thoughts, money, and clashes with her husband it took.

reading.ru: Он был неблагоразумно ревнив к дочерям и особенно к Ките, которая была его любимица, и на каждом шагу делал сцены княгине за то, что она компрометирует дочь.
reading.question: How did the old prince behave regarding his favorite daughter, Kitty?
options: He was unreasonably jealous and made scenes with the princess over compromising her
He encouraged her to go out unchaperoned
He wanted her to marry quickly regardless of the suitor
reading.correct: He was unreasonably jealous and made scenes with the princess over compromising her
reading.explain: The text says he was неблагоразумно ревнив к... Ките ... делал сцены княгине за то, что она компрометирует дочь.

reading.ru: Французский обычай родителям решать судьбу детей был не принят, осуждался.
reading.question: What was the princess's view of the French custom of parents deciding their children's fate?
options: It was not accepted and was condemned
It was fully embraced by Russian society
It was considered ideal for Kitty
It was a new and welcome idea
reading.correct: It was not accepted and was condemned
reading.explain: The text says this custom был не принят, осуждался — was not accepted, was condemned.

reading.ru: Английский обычай совершенной свободы девушки был тоже не принят и невозможен в русском обществе.
reading.question: How did the princess regard the English custom of complete freedom for young women?
options: Also not accepted and impossible in Russian society
reading.correct: Also not accepted and impossible in Russian society
reading.explain: The text says this custom был тоже не принят и невозможен в русском обществе.

reading.ru: Русский обычай сватовства считался чем-то безобразным.
reading.question: How was the traditional Russian custom of matchmaking regarded?
options: It was considered the only proper way
It was praised by all young people
reading.explain: The text says the Russian custom of matchmaking считался чем-то безобразным — was considered something shameful/unseemly.

reading.ru: На прошлой неделе Китти рассказала матери свой разговор во время мазурки с Вронским.
reading.question: What did Kitty tell her mother about the previous week?
options: Her conversation with Vronsky during the mazurka
A letter she received from Levin
reading.correct: Her conversation with Vronsky during the mazurka
reading.explain: The text says Kitty told her mother свой разговор во время мазурки с Вронским.

reading.ru: «И теперь я жду, как особенного счастья, приезда матушки из Петербурга», — сказал он.
reading.question: What did Vronsky say he was eagerly awaiting?
options: The end of the winter season
reading.explain: Vronsky says he awaits приезда матушки из Петербурга as a special happiness.

reading.ru: «Никогда, мама, никакой!» — отвечала Китти, покраснев и взглянув прямо в лицо матери.
reading.question: How did Kitty respond when her mother asked about keeping secrets from her?
options: She blushed and insisted she would never have any secret from her
She admitted she was hiding something
She refused to answer at all
reading.correct: She blushed and insisted she would never have any secret from her
reading.explain: Kitty answers «Никогда, мама, никакой!» while blushing and looking her mother in the face, meaning she would never keep a secret.
